# Std Deviation and Variance

![Std Deviation and Variance function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/statistics/03-std_variance.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Sample0 divides variance by n-1; Population1 by n. GS corrected skewness/kurtosis uses NIST G1/G2 (not NI-certified); kurtosis is Pearson normal3. Weighting 0 Sample (n-1), 1 Population (n).

## Types and connection rules

Sample0 divides variance by n-1; Population1 by n. GS corrected skewness/kurtosis uses NIST G1/G2 (not NI-certified); kurtosis is Pearson normal3.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.statistics.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: permitted by this profile.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.
- Shape rule: `statistics_exact_selected_variant_rank_and_record_schema`.
- Scalar lifting: no.
- Broadcasting: no.

**Input count:** 2; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `x` → `weighting`.
